title: Manager, Learning Experience and Digital Design
description: Promoted three times in three years, from curriculum developer to leading customer education design.

roles.title: Manager, Learning Experience and Digital Design
roles.description: Lead design and production for customer education.
highlights: Came up with a learning recommendation agent, the first one Okta could put in front of customers, and pitched it to executive leadership.
Content for Okta for AI Agents reached 1,500+ views and 155 logged-in customers within weeks.
Scaled learning for strategic business reviews set the production bar and led to a video series for 500+ customer success managers.
Built the Oktane kiosk. One year it issued skill badges. This year it was Authcade.

roles.title: Staff Learning Experience Designer
roles.description: Designed courses and simulations for Customer Acceleration.
highlights: Won the CEdMA Pinnacle Award for Innovation, Okta's first since 2017.
Raised average course consumption from 2.2 to 8+ courses a year with in-course simulations, without a matching rise in hosting cost.
Built a shared library of course blocks so new courses didn't start from scratch.
Brought Customer Acceleration under one standard across the learning platform, the site, communities, and support.
Course videos went from 2,452 to 4,386 views, and we could see which views became learners.
Gave the Next Generation Learning webinar, and a hands-on session at CEdMA Austin on shipping courses built with AI.

roles.title: Senior Curriculum Developer
roles.description: Built the catalog's feedback loop and added certification courses.
highlights: Built the first loop from learner feedback and video analytics back into the catalog, and archived 247+ courses almost nobody took.
Added 10+ certification courses over 13 months.
Got the team producing courses with AI in the workflow.

title: Learning Experience Designer
description: Owned quarterly releases and QA for 300+ courses.
highlights: Shipped quarterly updates for customers and employees with video, simulations, and knowledge checks.
Set one way of building 300 courses and cut QA by 2.5 business days per release.
Set up Jira workflows that saved the team about 20 hours a week.
Started a development program for the learning team.

title: LMS Analyst, Sales Enablement
description: Ran a learning platform of 1,200+ courses in five languages, connected to Salesforce.
highlights: Localized the platform and the courses for five languages.
Kept employee and partner courses current across 1,200+ titles.
Set one way of authoring for seven instructional designers.
Raised completion of required courses from 70% to 95%.
Connected learner data to Salesforce so partners could see certifications.
Ran the required-course cycle from assignment through completion.
